newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN OVERNIGHT RATES FIRM ON BORROWING.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN OVERNIGHT RATES FIRM ON BORROWING.

text.p: Pakistan overnight rates firmed on Friday on borrowing pressure despite an inflow of 1.5 billion rupees due to an open market operation maturity, dealers said.

The market opened with bids and offers at six and 14 percent respectively, a dealer said. Some initial deals were reported at 11 percent. Closing bids and offers were reported at 15.50 and 17 percent. One-week bids and offers were at 14 and 17 percent.
